note: Audit classification, not an official acceptance result. The Rehearsal 5 verdict is unchanged.

applicationOnly.scopeRule: UI-*, PF-*, EXT-DATA-*, WDL-* requirements except PF-019 (its open obligation is an agent-workflow obligation)

implementationCoverage.definition: (verified during rehearsal + implemented, verification missing) / 108; audit classification, not acceptance

applicationBehaviourCoverage.definition: application-only, additionally counting UI-021, UI-030 and UI-040, whose application obligations all passed and whose only open obligation is process evidence

verificationGap.definition: implemented requirements without adequate acceptance evidence

functionalGap.definition: requirements with a specified behaviour missing; codeUnconditional need code whatever the owner decides (AR-011, AR-019 are acceptance tooling, not application), the rest need code only if the owner keeps the clause as written

evidenceGap.definition: requirements whose remaining work is testing, binding, deployed execution or process evidence only (A + D + E)

unknownGap.definition: implementation status cannot be established; processStatusUnknown counts process requirements whose performance cannot be established

passableWithEvidenceAtDeadline.definition: every open obligation had admissible evidence (run 40620099844, at 1b9fb56) that only lacked a binding

independentReview.reviewer: independent review agent (no implementation or classification role)
